t: 孔拉德三世·冯·霍亨斯陶芬被选为克布伦茨的德国国王,由教宗代表特奥德温出席.
te: Konrad III von Hohenstaufen is elected king of Germany at Coblenz in the presence of the papal legate Theodwin.
dz: 孔拉德三世·冯·霍亨斯陶芬被选为克布伦茨的德国国王,由教宗代表特奥德温出席.
de: Konrad III von Hohenstaufen is elected king of Germany at Coblenz in the presence of the papal legate Theodwin.

t: 安提波佩·维克多四世因为克莱尔沃的伯纳德的煽动而放弃了对教宗的主张.
te: Antipope Victor IV gives up his claim to the papacy due to the instigation of Bernard of Clairvaux.
dz: 安提波佩·维克多四世因为克莱尔沃的伯纳德的煽动而放弃了对教宗的主张.
de: Antipope Victor IV gives up his claim to the papacy due to the instigation of Bernard of Clairvaux.

t: 苏格兰和英格兰之间的标准战.
te: Battle of the Standard between Scotland and England.
dz: 苏格兰和英格兰之间的标准战.
de: Battle of the Standard between Scotland and England.

t: 阿勒颇遭到大规模地震袭击;这是有史以来最具破坏性的地震之一.
te: A massive earthquake strikes Aleppo; it is one of the most destructive earthquakes ever.
dz: 阿勒颇遭到大规模地震袭击;这是有史以来最具破坏性的地震之一.
de: A massive earthquake strikes Aleppo; it is one of the most destructive earthquakes ever.

t: 黎安通被封为越南皇帝 二岁开始统治37年.
te: Lý Anh Tông is enthroned as emperor of Vietnam at the age of two, beginning a 37-year reign.
dz: 黎安通被封为越南皇帝 二岁开始统治37年.
de: Lý Anh Tông is enthroned as emperor of Vietnam at the age of two, beginning a 37-year reign.
